# external.impression__v1

## Purpose
GCS-backed parquet archive of served **display** ad impressions emitted by the MNTN bidder/ad-server. It is one of the two physical sources that the `impression_log` build UNIONs together: **impression__v1 = display**, `external.vastimpression__v1` = CTV/VAST video. `impression_log` is in turn what `cost_impression_log` (CIL) matches against — a CIL impression is flagged `unlinked=FALSE` (linked/enriched) when its impression id is found in `impression_log`, `unlinked=TRUE` (null `ad_served_id`) when it isn't. Reach for this table for raw served-impression detail (creative, size, exchange, geo, user IP, publisher/domain) at sub-second precision that hasn't yet been deduped/enriched into CIL, or to debug why an impression failed to link into CIL. Backing store: `gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/impression/dt=<date>/hh=<hour>/*.parquet` — a federated PARQUET external table, hive-partitioned on `dt`+`hh` (mode CUSTOM, sourceUriPrefix `gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/impression/`).

## Grain & keys
- **Grain:** one row per served display ad impression (ad-render event). ~18,055,056 rows/day (2026-07-15), ~795K/hour. This is the **raw pre-dedup** source — expect duplicate impressions; the deduped/billed layer is `cost_impression_log`.
- **Identity / link key:** `ad_served_id` (UUID, populated on 100% of rows in sample) — the impression identity that links into `cost_impression_log`. `guid` is a second per-row UUID.
- **Partition keys:** `dt` (DATE, event date) + `hh` (STRING hour, zero-padded `"00"`–`"23"`), both hive-derived from the GCS path.

## Column meanings (only the non-obvious ones)
- **epoch** — event time in **MICROSECONDS** since Unix epoch. Verified `epoch = UNIX_MICROS(time)` exactly (e.g. `epoch=1784118601814000` = `UNIX_MICROS('2026-07-15 12:30:01.814')`). Use `epoch` for sub-second ordering.
- **time** — the same instant as `epoch`, truncated to whole seconds (loses sub-second precision).
- **ip / original_ip** — INTERNAL server IP, mostly RFC1918 private (`10.x`, ~95% private in sample) — **NOT the user's IP**. Do not use for geo/identity. `original_ip` = `ip` before any rewrite.
- **bid_ip** — the real **public user IP** (~99.9% populated). This is the field to use for user IP / identity joins, matching the CIL fallback `COALESCE(NULLIF(ip,'0.0.0.0'), impression_log.bid_ip, …)`.
- **cpm / cpi** — pricing fields, **100% NULL** in current data (2026-07-15). Not populated; not a spend source (spend lives in `spend_log` / `cost_impression_log`).
- **advertiser_id / campaign_id** vs **original_aid / original_cid** — `original_*` are the IDs before any remap; in sample they equal `advertiser_id`/`campaign_id` (divergence only when an impression was reassigned).
- **group_id** — campaign group id. **section_id** — exchange section/placement id (frequently NULL).
- **domain / subdomain / publisher** — `domain` = registrable/serving domain (e.g. `googlesyndication.com`); `subdomain` = subdomain label, often an obfuscated hash when the exchange masks it (`"www"` when not); `publisher` = the actual publisher site (e.g. `www.kentucky.com`).
- **app_bundle** — populated on only ~0.1% of rows: this is web/display inventory; app/CTV inventory lives in `vastimpression__v1`.
- **exchange_id** — numeric exchange id (only ~2 distinct in a sample hour). **exchange_io** — exchange insertion-order string (often NULL).
- **user_agent** — STRUCT(`is_mobile_device`, `browser`, `operating_system`, `device_type`, `browser_version`); top-level `browser` / `device` are flattened duplicates of the struct fields.
- **ttd_impression_id / td_site / td_id** — The Trade Desk passthrough identifiers; **deal_id** = PMP/private-deal id. **ga_tracking_id / ga_client_id** — Google Analytics passthrough (rarely populated).
- **geoname_id / metro_id / country / region / city / postal_code / continent / locale_code / time_zone** — MaxMind geo resolution of the user IP.
- **is_baseline / cache_buster** — flags, mostly NULL. **creative_id / creative_size_id / width / height** — served creative and its rendered dimensions.
- **_source_file / _batch_id** — ingestion provenance (GCS object path + load batch id). **dt / hh** — hive partition columns.

## Joins & relationships
- **→ `impression_log` (build input, not a join):** `impression_log` = UNION of `external.impression__v1` (display) + `external.vastimpression__v1` (CTV/VAST). Same-grain append, no fan-out. `impression_log` lookback = **3 hours** — late GCS arrivals beyond 3h need a manual restate.
- **→ `cost_impression_log` (CIL):** CIL matches `impression_log` by impression identity; a CIL row is `unlinked=FALSE` (enriched) when matched, `unlinked=TRUE` (null `ad_served_id`) when not — 1:1 on impression identity. CIL is the deduped/billed layer; **this table is the raw pre-dedup source** (expect duplicates here, not in CIL).
- **Dimension joins (all N:1 from impression rows — no fan-out from this side):** `advertiser_id` → `integrationprod.advertisers` (filter `deleted=FALSE AND is_test=FALSE`); `campaign_id` → `campaigns` (use `funnel_level` for stage; `objective_id` unreliable); `creative_id` → creatives. Partner-side dims are 1-row-per-id lookups.
- **User IP:** use `bid_ip`. No IP→IP bridging exists in BQ (external identity only).

## Gotchas
- **Use `bid_ip`, not `ip`, for the user IP** — `ip`/`original_ip` are internal server IPs (~95% RFC1918 private).
- **epoch is MICROSECONDS** (units differ per table: `bidder_bid_events`=ms, `bidder_auction_events`=µs). `time` is second-truncated.
- **cpm/cpi are 100% NULL** — not a spend source.
- **Raw pre-dedup feed:** duplicate impressions are expected here; dedup happens downstream in `cost_impression_log`, not here.
- **External hive-partitioned parquet:** `bq show` reports `numRows=0` / `numBytes=0` and dry-run reports "lower bound of 0 bytes" — EXPECTED for federated GCS, not an error. You cannot get a byte estimate before running.
- **No `deleted`/`is_test` filters** exist on this raw feed; those live on the integrationprod dims you join to.
- **Late data:** GCS objects can land after the 3h `impression_log` lookback; those rows exist in this external table but may be missing from `impression_log`/CIL until a restate.
- **App/CTV inventory is essentially absent** here (`app_bundle` ~0.1%); for CTV use `vastimpression__v1`.

## Cost & partitioning notes
- **ALWAYS filter `dt`** (add `hh` for intra-day work). This is a federated GCS parquet external table with no BQ partition-pruning *estimate* — objects are scanned from GCS at query time. Column pruning works because parquet is columnar; `dt`/`hh` prune which GCS objects are read.
- **Measured (billed, labeled by exact column set — 2026-07-15):**
  - `COUNT(*)`, 1 day (`dt` only) → **0.0 GB** — reads parquet footers (row counts) only, effectively free. (18,055,056 rows.)
  - `MIN(ad_served_id)` [1 string col], **1 HOUR** (`dt`+`hh`) → **0.030 GB** billed.
  - `MIN(ad_served_id)` [1 string col], **1 DAY** (`dt` only) → **0.687 GB** billed.
  - → Adding `hh` to a `dt` filter cuts a single-hour scan ~23x (same one column, 0.687→0.030 GB). Cost scales ~linearly with hours and with the number/width of columns selected.
  - A 7-column, 1-hour aggregate scan measured ~1.6 GB; **never `SELECT *`** over the archive (~48 columns × full parquet chunks = many GB/day).

## Example queries
```sql
-- One hour of served display impressions with the user IP + creative
SELECT time, ad_served_id, advertiser_id, campaign_id, creative_id,
       bid_ip, domain, publisher, width, height
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.impression__v1`
WHERE dt = DATE '2026-07-15' AND hh = '12'
LIMIT 100;
```
